label: Precision & Electronics (精密・電子) segment
definition: Ebara's Precision & Electronics (精密・電子) reportable segment, exactly as the issuer defines it in every annual securities report and half-year report reviewed for this packet. The issuer's own business-description table (事業の内容, e.g. ebara_fy2025_yuho_jp physical p.7) states the segment's constituent products as, verbatim: 真空ポンプ、CMP装置、めっき装置、排ガス処理装置 -- vacuum pumps, CMP equipment, plating equipment and exhaust-gas treatment equipment, together and undifferentiated at every level this issuer discloses. Dry vacuum pumps, components and subsystems are out of scope atlas-wide (AGENTS.md); exhaust-gas treatment equipment is an abatement subsystem, also out of scope. The issuer states explicitly (ebara_fy2025_yuho_jp physical p.142, '製品及びサービスに関する情報': '製品及びサービスの区分が報告セグメントと同一であるため、記載を省略しています。') that no product-level revenue split finer than this segment total exists in its disclosure -- confirmed across all five annual securities reports and both half-year reports held. Filed at multi_equipment on exactly the discipline TOWA's Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment and DISCO's Precision Processing Machines line were filed on: a basket spanning two or more equipment categories (here, cmp and plating) that the source does not split, mixed further with out-of-scope pump and abatement revenue that this packet does not attempt to net out. NEVER allocate any part of this figure to cmp or plating alone, or to vacuum pumps/exhaust-gas treatment on their own -- the split is not in the source. Segment name was 精密・電子事業 ('Precision & Electronics business') under the pre-January-2023 three-segment structure and 精密・電子 ('Precision & Electronics', one of five market-facing companies) from January 2023 onward; the segment's own product scope is identical under both labels -- only the SIBLING Fluid Machinery segment was split by the January 2023 reorganisation, confirmed by the FY2022 figures matching exactly whether read as-originally-reported or as the FY2023 report's restated comparative column (see the entity note).

label: Ebara company-wide totals
definition: Ebara's consolidated group total across all five reportable segments (Buildings & Industry, Energy, Infrastructure, Environment, Precision & Electronics; three segments -- Fluid Machinery, Environmental Plant, Precision & Electronics -- before the January 2023 reorganisation). Four of the five segments (everything except Precision & Electronics) are standard pumps, compressors, turbines, cryopumps, HVAC/chillers, blowers and waste-incineration/water-treatment plant -- non-semiconductor-equipment businesses by this atlas's own categories, making up roughly two-thirds of group revenue in FY2025 by subtraction (five-segment total 957,059 less Precision & Electronics 342,267 = approximately 614,792 of the 958,285 JPY million company total) and never to be read as semiconductor-equipment revenue of any kind.
